name: mHC with nanochat routing and readout
tagline: Four streams, near-uniform initial reads and a learned final readout.
description: Four-stream mHC with the router initialization and final sigmoid readout from the 50M nanochat comparison. The full-attention shell and shared training schedule follow the published NextTransformer mHC configuration.
mechanism: Four streams and one RMS-normalized projection per sublayer
Learned sigmoid reads, post-write weights and a 20-iteration log-space Sinkhorn mix
Input-dependent final read from the four streams
limitations: Research comparison with random attention-output and FFN down projections. Routing uses native tensor operators implementing the nanochat equations; kernel rounding can differ from Transformer Engine.
